headline: Executive order on how the U.S. government provides help to foreign countries after disasters.
what_it_does: This 1995 order deals with U.S. assistance to other countries hit by disasters. It appears to set out which federal officials, likely including the Secretary of Defense working with the Secretary of State, may direct disaster relief abroad. No summary was provided, so the exact details are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: People in foreign countries struck by disasters
who_it_affects.how: They may receive U.S. relief aid organized under the rules this order sets.
They may be directed to carry out or support disaster relief efforts abroad.
